hero.title: I ship mobile apps end to end, and stay until the release is stable.
hero.subtitle: Android and full-stack engineer in Seoul, working remotely with teams anywhere. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, React Native, Cloudflare. Available for contract work.

services.label: What I can take on
services.ship: Ship an Android app end to end, or port an existing iOS app to Android.
services.rescue: Rescue a release: crashes, ANRs, store rejections, billing and subscription integration.
services.backend: Build or fix the backend: Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, Hono, Node, Postgres.
services.ai: Add AI features to a product that already has users.

availability.label: What I can take on
availability.text: Remote contract, anywhere. Based in Seoul, so my evenings overlap with US mornings. I reply within one business day.
